job.job_title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer Industrial Manufacturing
job.job_description:
Senior Agentic AI Engineer Industrial Manufacturing




Role & responsibilities

Build the intelligence layer by combining industrial context with AI, data, integration and governance capabilities. This is a hands-on delivery role.




Must Have Technical / Functional Skills

Hands-on Python software engineering and secure REST/API integration
Experience building RAG or LLM applications with grounded enterprise data
Multi-step agent workflows, tool calling, state management, memory and human approval
Evaluation of groundedness, tool selection, response quality, access control and failure handling
Understanding of PLM, MOM/MES, quality, maintenance and deterministic OT control boundaries



Good-to-Have Skills

Siemens Teamcenter, Opcenter, Industrial Edge, Insights Hub or Mendix exposure
OPC UA, MQTT, manufacturing genealogy or industrial knowledge graphs
Battery manufacturing, predictive quality or maintenance use cases
